# Quartzite Orders ERP — Complete Step-by-Step User Manual Screenshot Index

**Environment:** Cloudflare Pages Production + Supabase PostgreSQL  
**Resolution:** Desktop 1600 × 1000 HD  
**Status Date:** September 2026  
**Total Screenshots:** 125 high-resolution captures across 12 departments.

This comprehensive screenshot archive serves as the authoritative, end-to-end visual dataset for the role-based system user manual in English and Arabic. It captures every transitional step of commercial, procurement, inventory, logistics, and financial workflows.
